catalysts.headline: BofA Securities downgrades PCG to Neutral from Buy, cuts price target $24 -> $13; shares closed $13.27 that Monday
PG&E Corp launches strategic review aimed at regaining investment-grade credit ratings (lost in 2019 Chapter 11); management says wildfire policy 'is holding us back'
California Assembly declines to vote on SB 492; bill dies without passing for the session
catalysts.impact: mixed -- avoided the specific bad version, but no durable wildfire-liability fix enacted

catalysts.headline: SB 492 compromise text (lacking liability protections) revealed; Wells Fargo cut to Equal Weight; BMO, Mizuho, HSBC also cut ratings same week

Wells Fargo cut to Equal Weight from Overweight (PT $24 from $25); BMO cut to Market Perform from Outperform (PT $21 from $28); Mizuho cut to Neutral from Outperform (PT $16 from $21) — all citing unresolved wildfire liability after the SB 492 revision
California State Assembly amended SB 492 to remove wildfire liability protection for utilities, prompting analyst downgrades sector-wide

Q2 2026: core EPS $0.40 (vs $0.31 Y/Y), GAAP EPS $0.33, revenue $5.90B (~flat Y/Y); reaffirmed FY2026 core EPS guidance $1.64-$1.66; completed $2.2B Utility bond issuance in June, $4.4B total debt financings YTD
catalysts.impact: earnings beat, revenue roughly in line
